test_case_name: Navigate from Privacy Policy to Terms of Use and verify Terms page loads

intents.intent: Click the 'Terms of Use' link on the Privacy Policy page
And then check that the Terms of Use page is displayed

test_case_name: Navigate from Privacy Policy to Terms of Use, select 'One way' trip, and verify selection

intents.intent: Click the 'Terms of Use' link on the Privacy Policy page
Click the 'One way' radio button on the Terms of Use page
And then check that the 'One way' trip option is selected

test_case_name: Navigate from Privacy Policy to Terms of Use, select 'Return trip', and verify selection

intents.intent: Click the 'Terms of Use' link on the Privacy Policy page
Click the 'Return trip' radio button on the Terms of Use page
And then check that the 'Return trip' option is selected

test_case_name: Navigate from Privacy Policy to Terms of Use, enter departure and destination, and search for flights

intents.intent: Click the 'Terms of Use' link on the Privacy Policy page
Type $name into the 'Departure' input field on the Terms of Use page
Type $name into the 'Destination' input field on the Terms of Use page
Click the 'Search' button on the Terms of Use page
And then check that the search results are displayed based on the entered departure and destination
